description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing in profile looking out the picture window of her Abiquiu studio; the room and O'Keeffe are in shadow, the twin bed is in the foreground, and a view of the desert landscape with mountain and the meadow below can be seen from the window. Sitting on the large window ledge is a singular long steer horn and multiple large rocks.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe in Abiquiu Studio
